title: How to Make a Sweet‑And‑Spicy Pineapple Glaze for Pork Kebabs
keyword: sweet spicy pineapple glaze pork kebabs
meta_description: Elevate your pork kebabs with a sweet and spicy pineapple glaze, perfect for a summer BBQ. Use a vertical gyro pan for easy oven-roasting.
html:
As the summer months approach, backyard barbecues and outdoor gatherings become more frequent, and with them, the need for delicious and easy-to-make kebabs. One of our favorite ways to add flavor to pork kebabs is with a sweet and spicy pineapple glaze, made with just a few simple ingredients. In this article, we'll walk you through the process of making this glaze and show you how to use a vertical gyro pan to roast your kebabs to perfection. Sweet and Spicy Pineapple Glaze for Pork Kebabs

Why a Sweet and Spicy Pineapple Glaze?

The sweetness of the pineapple pairs perfectly with the spicy kick of the red pepper flakes, creating a flavor combination that's both balanced and exciting. Plus, the glaze is easy to make and can be adjusted to suit your taste preferences.

Gathering Ingredients

To make the sweet and spicy pineapple glaze, you'll need the following ingredients:

  • 1 cup pineapple juice
  • 1/2 cup brown sugar
  • 2 tablespoons soy sauce
  • 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
  • 1 teaspoon grated ginger
  • 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes

For the kebabs, you'll need:

  • 1 pound pork tenderloin or loin, cut into 1-inch pieces
  • 1/2 cup olive oil
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro

Making the Glaze

In a medium saucepan, combine the pineapple juice, brown sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, grated ginger, and red pepper flakes. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the glaze has thickened slightly. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.

Preparing the Kebabs

Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Thread the pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece. Brush the skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic and cilantro. Place the skewers in the Vertical Gyro Pan with Skewer for Oven and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.

Glazing the Kebabs

After the kebabs have roasted for 10-12 minutes, brush them with the sweet and spicy pineapple glaze. Return the skewers to the oven and roast for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized and sticky.

FAQ

Q: Can I make the glaze ahead of time?

A: Yes, you can make the glaze ahead of time and store it in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat before using.

Q: What type of red pepper flakes should I use?

A: You can use either sweet or hot red pepper flakes, depending on your desired level of heat.

Q: Can I use a different type of protein in place of pork?

A: Yes, you can use chicken, beef, or even tofu in place of pork. Adjust the cooking time and glazing time accordingly.
